turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me, so start with who decided that and when.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.

I'm writing that down: Wednesday the 28th, 11:31, 11:52, 11:58. Kids write in one place and paste into another, Hale, so that shows where the essay landed, not who wrote it. And 4.1 says you speak to the student first, so did you ask Owen before that zero went in?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That's your reading of a paste, Hale, not proof of who wrote it. You still haven't said whether Owen was heard before that zero went in, and I'm noting that you haven't.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned here, Hale. You entered a zero before speaking to my son and before calling me, so answer 4.1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that you tell me whether Owen was heard before that mark was entered, as 4.1 requires. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table.
What moved her: Owning in one sentence that you entered the zero before calling her earned a flat sign of ground, and your version history with exact times was specific and dated enough that she wrote it down.
What cost ground: When she argued the essay could have been written elsewhere and pasted in, you restated the timeline as an accusation and then asked what Owen was doing at midnight, which left her procedural question unanswered and handed her an easy refusal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence put the essay on the night of Wednesday October 28 near midnight, the night before it was due, right next to the kind of late night she saw; that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she said kids write in one place and paste into another, answer her question about whether Owen was heard first and then offer a private 4.4 rewrite in writing, instead of asking what Owen was doing at midnight.
